mode: frozen development feasibility study on previously seen archived clouds; not independent confirmation
question: Can the explicitly defined retarded extension be integrated over the fixed spatial detector and two fixed time windows accurately enough to support a later fluctuation-transfer validation?
selection: first eight archived nu512 cloud IDs, fixed before this integration; no selection by detector output
domain: unchanged open Omega4: abs(t)+r<4; exact stored binary64 coordinates
rho: nu/(512*pi/3), never observed N divided by volume
source: unchanged normalized compact bump at t0=-1, radius1/2, carrier k=4, initial derivative zero
history_adapter: unchanged H1=f+(t+1)*g on all cloud nodes t<=-1

detector.time_extension: new declared finite time response around the historical td=1; not a reinterpretation of the old instantaneous detector
detector.readout: normalized linear complex field average, uniform in each spacetime window; no intensity/probability claim
detector.extension: phi_C(p)=sum_{y in C,y prec p} beta*w_e(n(y,p))*phi_C(y); virtual query p never inserted into the cloud; n counts only original cloud elements
detector.causal_order: strict timelike order; exact-null boundaries have zero Lebesgue measure
detector.partition_rule: exact integer geometry-only priority=cell_volume*(uncertain point relations + N if sphere-boundary); longest physical edge bisected, smallest axis on ties; insertion order breaks cell ties
detector.quadrature: enclosed ranges on every full spacetime box; outside sphere zero, partial sphere cells include zero; no Monte Carlo cubature or unbounded extrapolation

error_budgets.compact_field_scale: A/e, the maximum magnitude of the initial normalized bump
error_budgets.compact_continuum_detector_reference: NOT_QUALIFIED; no compact continuum mean accuracy decision
error_budgets.separation: geometry exact; integration enclosure separate from nodal precision, rounded-history, float-nodal-solve diagnostics; wave oracle gives separate history versus operator/domain contributions; correlated terms are not added as independent variances

statistics.outputs: enclosed finite-sample means and unbiased two-window covariance for all five fields
statistics.population_inference: NONE; no Gaussian, independence-between-windows, stationarity or white-noise assumption
statistics.same_cloud: both windows, all fields, history and all propagation share the same geometry
statistics.future_independent_ensemble: NOT_FROZEN: must define a predictive operator covariance model, stability and error budget, population confidence method and sample size/power before fresh data; existing v0.8 holdouts are not reused as fresh confirmation

stopping.complete_fixed_inventory: all eight archived IDs and both windows even if early quadrature fails; no replacement or resolution increase after outputs
stopping.quadrature_failure: QUADRATURE_HOLD, no precise variance interpretation or independent production
stopping.resource_failure: RESOURCE_HOLD with missing slots retained, no redraw
stopping.all_development_budgets_pass: DETECTOR_INTEGRATION_READY_ONLY; not population transfer, continuum, quantum-gravity or G1 qualification
